summary: BizBuzz 2026 ran two six-week camps side by side, KidPreneur Camp and VentureLab, alongside the Fish Tank competition and the Naperville Children's Business Fair, reaching 365 students.

programs.title: 2026 Summer Entrepreneurship Camp
programs.description: Two six-week programs running simultaneously, KidPreneur Camp and VentureLab, from June 5 to July 10, covering ideation, finance, marketing and prototyping, business models, presentation skills, and a mock pitch.

programs.title: Fish Tank 2026
programs.description: Two separate tracks, KidPreneur and VentureLab, so every young entrepreneur competed against peers at their level.

programs.title: 2026 Naperville Children's Business Fair
programs.description: BizBuzz returned to the Naperville Children's Business Fair, working with 100+ young entrepreneurs.

timeline.label: 2026 Summer Camps Begin
timeline.detail: KidPreneur Camp and VentureLab launch simultaneously.

timeline.label: Final Camp Session
timeline.detail: Mock pitch session closes both six-week programs.
